## Semantic version impact

- [ ] PATCH - bug fix, no parameter or behaviour change for consumers
- [ ] MINOR - new template or new optional parameter (backwards compatible)
- [ ] MAJOR - removed/renamed parameter, changed default, new mandatory policy

## Checklist

- [ ] `docs/catalogue.md` updated for every added/changed parameter
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry under `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] Tool versions changed together with their SHA-256 digests
- [ ] Tested from a sandbox Azure DevOps project against this branch (`ref: refs/heads/<branch>`)
